name: balcony
description: a small wrought-iron balcony overlooking the overgrown garden far below. the railing is rusted and creaks alarmingly when you lean on it. the night air is cold and fresh, a welcome relief from the mansion's oppressive atmosphere. the moon hangs low, casting silver light across the garden. from here, you can see the graveyard gate and the mausoleum beyond.

items.name: railing
items.description: a rusted iron railing that creaks ominously when you lean on it. it's not safe, but it's held for 130 years. one section is wrapped with a faded ribbon — a woman's hair ribbon, blue silk.

items.name: blue_ribbon
items.description: a faded blue silk ribbon tied in a lover's knot. it has been here for over a century, yet the silk is still soft and untorn.

exits.description: french doors to a small balcony. moonlight filters through the dusty glass.
